newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hugo Boss posts improved 3-month results.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Boss posts improved 3-month results.

text.p: German clothing retailer Hugo Boss AG said on Monday that there had been a very clear improvement in results in the first three months of the year but warned the development should not yet be seen as a trend.
"There has been a very clear increase in the first three months," board member Joerg-Viggo Mueller told a news conference, adding however "that this increase could not be extrapolated for full year."

Hugo Boss chairman Joachim Vogt also said that he expected the new women's fashion line Hugo Women, which Hugo Boss plans to launch early next year, to match sales of the Hugo men's line within five years.
Hugo sales totalled 41 million marks last year and are expected to rise 15 pct this year.
Overall the group said sales and earnings should rise by five percent this year.
